metadata.name: GetProductProcessingParameter
metadata.description: This API is use to Gets Product level configuration details for a specific product.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: ID assigned to a Program Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:Fixed value provided by CoreCard.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: Logo
children.description: get or set Logo

children.name: ProductName
children.description: Reflects the name of product for the account Valid Values: a-z Format:xxxxxx Example:abcsolutionsrevolving Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ProductParentName
children.description: Reflects the name of parent record name for product Valid Values: a-z Format:xxxxxx Example:abcsolutionsrevolving Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ProgramName
children.description: Name of Program Valid Values:0-9 a-z Format:xxxx Example: ABC Solutions Allowable Values: 50

children.name: PrimaryCurrencyCode
children.description: 3 digit Code assiciated with the Currency Valid Values: Refer' Primary Currency Code' section of Appendix Format: XXX Example: 840 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ParentInstitution
children.description: Name of Parent Institution for the product Valid Values: a-z A-Z Format: XXXXX Example: Clientabc Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountID
children.description: The unique identifier of the primary cardholder for the accounts in this product. The Account ID is used to match an incoming account record to the correct Product. Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: CardType
children.description: Identifies the type of card, based on BIN selection Valid Values: Visa, Mastercard, Discover, Star Format: XXXX Example: Visa Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ProgramManager
children.description: Identifies the name of the Program Manager associated with this record Valid Values: a-z Format: XXX Allowable Values: 50

children.name: SubProductType
children.description: It provides a description of the type of card being processed Valid Values: Card Agreement, SPECIAL, ELECTRON, DEBIT, SECURED,  STAFF SMART, STAFF, PRIVATE LABEL 1 (User defined), DEAL Format: XXXXX Example: Debit Allowable Values: 5

children.name: BankIdentificationNumber
children.description: The Bank Identification Number (BIN) identifies the manner in which authorizations, transactions, and settlement occur and identifies the issuer Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: 424898 Allowable Values: 46

children.name: AssociationProductType
children.description: The card line being issued product, such as ATM, Consumer Debit, MasterCard Black, etc. Valid Values: A - ATM, B - Business Card etc. Refer to Appendix file for list of valid values Format: XXXXXX Example: A Allowable Values: 10

children.name: NumberOfSecondaryIDs
children.description: Indicates the number of customer secondary IDs that may be required for all customers in this product Valid Values: 1,2,3 Format: X Example: 1 Allowable Values: 2

children.name: AutomaticallyClose
children.description: Indicates if accounts for this product will be set to automatically close after a defined number of months in an inactive status (as set in the AutoCloseMonths tag) Valid Values: Yes, No Format: XXX Example: No Condition: Disabled for RecordType = Template Allowable Values: 5

children.name: AutoCloseMonths
children.description: The number of months accounts will automatically close after an inactive status is reached Valid Values: 0-9 Format: X Example: 2

children.name: PIIRequired
children.description: Indicates if PII (personal identification information) is required or not for this product Valid Values: 1 - No, 0 - Yes Format: X Example: 1

children.name: MaximumCreditLimit
children.description: The maximum credit limit that can be assigned on accounts for this product Valid Values: 0-9 Format: $xx.xx Example: $100.50

children.name: SuppressCreditLimitInStmtOnline
children.description: Indicates wheather to display Credit limit online for all accounts in this product Valid Values: 1-Yes, 0-No Format: XX Example: 0

children.name: SuppressCreditLimitInStmtOutgoing
children.description: Indicates wheather to display Credit limit in out going statements for all accounts in this product Valid Values: 1-Yes, 0-No Format: XX Example: 0

children.name: SuppressOpenToBuyInStmtOnline
children.description: Indicates wheather to display open to buy online for all accounts in this product Valid Values: 1-Yes, 0-No Format: XX Example: 0

children.name: SuppressOpenToBuyInStmtOutgoing
children.description: Indicates wheather to display open to buy in out going statements for all accounts in this product Valid Values: 1-Yes, 0-No Format: XX Example: 0

children.name: ProductStatement
children.description: Indicates if a printed statement should be generated in the outgoing statement file for this product Valid Values: Accounts that have a balance, All statements regardless of activity, No Printed Statement Format: XXXXX Example: No Printed Statement Allowable Values: 5

children.name: AccruedInterestReporting
children.description: Indicates if  anticipated accrued interest is calculated in the cycle run for all plan segments that are either interest bearing or are deferred, but will be interest bearing by the end of the current calendar month (their interest start date is set to a date between the day after cycle and the current month end date) Valid Values: Yes,No Format: XX Example: No Allowable Values: 8

children.name: SummaryProduct
children.description: When set, this Product record is a summary product with no BIN number required.  Therefore, the processor may have multiple products within one BIN capable of sharing a card number range. Valid Values: 0-No,1-Yes Format: X Example: 0

children.name: NumberOfStatementMessages
children.description: The number of statement messages allowed on statements for this product Valid Values: 0-10 Format: X Example: 2 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: DuplicateCheckType
children.description: Indicates which record to use to perform a duplicate check validation Valid Values: Immediate Parent Institution, Immediate Parent Product, Institution Product Format: XXX Example: Institution Product

children.name: NumberOfDuplicateAccounts
children.description: Indicates number of duplicate accounts that can be created under this product, if n is a non-zero integer value entered in this field, then we will have total n+1 accounts in the system with similar data Valid Values: 0-9

children.name: FirstValidationField
children.description: Indicates first field value that will be used to perform duplicate check Valid Values:  1-SSN,2- ID,3- First Name, 4-Last Name, 5-Mobile number, 6-Email ID,7- Date of Birth Condition: This field becomes mandatory if AllowDuplicateCheck is set to Yes Allowable Values: 25

children.name: SecondValidationField
children.description: Indicates second field value that will be used to perform duplicate check in combination with value for FirstValidationField Valid Values:  1-SSN,2- ID,3- First Name, 4-Last Name, 5-Mobile number, 6-Email ID,7- Date of Birth Condition:  Value in this field cannot be set unless a value is mentioned for FirstValidationField tag Allowable Values: 25

children.name: ThirdValidationField
children.description: Indicates third field value that will be used to perform duplicate check in combination with value for FirstValidationField and SecondValidationField Valid Values:  1-SSN,2- ID,3- First Name, 4-Last Name, 5-Mobile number, 6-Email ID,7- Date of Birth Condition:  Value in this field cannot be set unless a non-null value is mentioned for FirstValidationField and SecondValidationField tag Allowable Values: 25

children.name: ProductMessageGroup
children.description: Indicates the Product Message Group used to define messages for this product Valid Values: a-z Format: XXX Example: ABCPMG Allowable Values: 30

children.name: PlanSegmentArchivalMonths
children.description: The number of months you wish to retain zero balance plan segments for this product Valid Values: null,6 - 99 Format: XX Example: 12 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AccountArchivalMonths
children.description: The number of months you wish to retain zero balance accounts for this product.   After this many months at zero balance, the accounts are archived. Valid Values: 6 - 99 Format: XX Example: 12 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ExistingCustomerSearchBasis
children.description: Must return the Existing Customer Record Search basis as set for the Product Valid Values: 0 = Institution and 1 = Owning Partner Format: X Example: 1 Allowable Values: 1

children.name: AllowDuplicateCheck
children.description: Indicates if Duplicate check is allowed for this product on not Valid values: Yes,No Format: XXX Example: Yes Allowable Values: 5

children.name: ValidatingPartnerID
children.description: Validate Partner ID Valid values: Yes,No Format: XXX Example: Yes Allowable Values: 5
